title: Elements of Agricultural Chemistry
author: Thomas Anderson

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Anderson (1819–1874) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Elements of Agricultural Chemistry" by Thomas Anderson is a scientific publication written in the mid-19th century. The work aims to provide a fundamental understanding of agricultural chemistry, specifically tailored for farmers and those unacquainted with detailed chemical science.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Named creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
